weight.title: Weight
weight.description: Set the body weight of the generated model in kilograms. This affects the body shape and proportions.

ethnicity.title: Ethnicity
ethnicity.description: Select the ethnicity of the generated model. This affects skin tone, facial features, and overall appearance.

preset.title: Preset
preset.description: Choose the gender and age category for the generated model. This determines the body type and appearance of the person in the final image.

background.title: Background
background.description: Choose the studio backdrop color for the generated image. Different backgrounds work better for different clothing colors.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Describe additional details for the generated image. This helps guide the AI to create more specific results.
prompt.placeholder: e.g. Studio fashion model wearing the outfit, natural lighting...
